description: Service, schema and guard groundwork for the REST API (plan.md items 1-6). ServiceError gets a `kind` (conflict | invalid | not_found) so the API can map it to 409/422/404 while the UI keeps showing e.message. Services gain what the API needs and the UI keeps using: getParticipantById, addParticipant returning the id, not-found errors for removeParticipant/setCheckedIn, setSeeds, deleteDraftTournament, parseModuleConfig/parseRequirements, reportForParticipant (same agree/dispute state machine as reportResult), verifyApiKey returning the key name with a 60 s lastUsedAt throttle. match_messages gets nullable author_id + api_key_name so messages posted by a key show as organizer messages labelled with its name. New API key guard in src/lib/server/auth/apiKey.ts. No REST routes yet. Depends on nothing; FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: src/lib/server/services/errors.ts: add `export type ServiceErrorKind = 'conflict' | 'invalid' | 'not_found';` and give ServiceError `readonly kind: ServiceErrorKind;` set in `constructor(message: string, kind: ServiceErrorKind = 'conflict') { super(message); this.kind = kind; }` (explicit field, no parameter property). Doc comment: the REST API answers conflict with 409 (the tournament's phase or state forbids it), invalid with 422 (the input breaks a rule), not_found with 404.

Classify throws (all others stay the default conflict): matches.ts loadMatch 'Match not found.' and clearHelp 'Match not found.' -> 'not_found'; chat.ts postMessage 'Match not found.' -> 'not_found'; matches.ts resultFor 'Scores must be whole numbers, zero or more.' and 'Elimination matches need a winner, so the scores must differ.' -> 'invalid'; matches.ts 'Only the players of this match can report its result.' -> 'invalid'; participants.ts addParticipant `There is no user called "${username}".` -> 'invalid'; tournaments.ts setStructure `parsed.error.issues[0].message` -> 'invalid'; tournaments.ts setTheme 'That theme is not available.' -> 'invalid'.

src/lib/server/services/participants.ts: add `getParticipantById(tournamentId, participantId)` after getParticipant (same shape, filters participants.id). addParticipant: `.insert(...).returning({ id: participants.id })` and `return row.id` (UI action ignores it). removeParticipant and setCheckedIn: add `.returning({ id: participants.id })` and `if (!row) throw new ServiceError('Participant not found.', 'not_found');`. Add after writeSeeds: `/** Organizer: seeds the participants in the given order, which must list each of them once. */ export async function setSeeds(tournament, order: string[])` -> assertNotStarted(tournament); db.transaction: ids = (await listParticipants(tournament.id, tx)).map(p => p.id); if (order.length !== ids.length || new Set(order).size !== order.length || order.some(id => !ids.includes(id))) throw new ServiceError('List every participant exactly once.', 'invalid'); await writeSeeds(tx, tournament.id, order).

src/lib/server/services/tournaments.ts: after deleteTournament add `/** Deletes a tournament that hasn't been published. The REST API uses it: unlike the admin page, it doesn't ask for the address to confirm. */ export async function deleteDraftTournament(tournament: Tournament)` -> if (tournament.status !== 'draft') throw new ServiceError('Only draft tournaments can be deleted here. Delete published ones from the admin page.'); await deleteTournament(tournament.id). Keep deleteTournament for the UI.

src/lib/server/services/requirements.ts: extract the tail of readModuleConfig into `/** Checks a module's tournament options with its `tournamentConfig`. */ export function parseModuleConfig(module: AuthModule, raw: Record<string, unknown>)` returning the same `{ ok: true; config } | { ok: false; error }` (error `${module.name}: ${issues[0].message}`); readModuleConfig ends with `return parseModuleConfig(module, raw);`. Add `/** Checks requirements sent to the REST API: enabled modules, each once, with valid options. */ export function parseRequirements(input: Requirement[], modules: AuthModule[]): { ok: true; requirements: Requirement[] } | { ok: false; error: string }` with errors `There is no auth module called "${moduleId}".` and `${module.name} is required twice.`.

src/lib/server/services/matches.ts: add `/** Who reports for one side: the player, or an API key on behalf of a participant (M7). */ type Reporter = { userId: string } | { participantId: string; apiKeyId: string };`. Change `sideOf(tournament, match, by: { userId: string } | { participantId: string })` to load the participant with getParticipant(tournament.id, by.userId) or getParticipantById(tournament.id, by.participantId); requestHelp passes `{ userId }`. Move the body of reportResult into private `async function report(tournament, matchId, by: Reporter, scores)`; in it `const report = { entrants: result.entrants, scores, userId: 'userId' in by ? by.userId : null, apiKeyId: 'apiKeyId' in by ? by.apiKeyId : null, updatedAt: new Date() }` (rename the local to avoid shadowing, e.g. `row`), used in both `.values({...})` and `onConflictDoUpdate({ set })`. `export async function reportResult(tournament, matchId, userId: string, scores)` keeps its doc comment and returns `report(tournament, matchId, { userId }, scores)`. Add `/** An API key reports for one of the match's players, with the same rules as `reportResult`. */ export async function reportForParticipant(tournament, matchId, by: { participantId: string; apiKeyId: string }, scores: Scores)` returning `report(tournament, matchId, by, scores)`. setMatchResult/Override stay as they are.

src/lib/server/services/apiKeys.ts: `/** `lastUsedAt` is written at most this often, so a busy key doesn't write on every request. */ const LAST_USED_INTERVAL = 60_000;` and `export async function verifyApiKey(key: string, now = new Date())`: after the timingSafeEqual check, `if (!row.lastUsedAt || now.getTime() - row.lastUsedAt.getTime() >= LAST_USED_INTERVAL) await db.update(apiKeys).set({ lastUsedAt: now }).where(eq(apiKeys.id, row.id));` and `return { id: row.id, orgId: row.orgId, name: row.name };`. Update its doc comment (returns id, organization and name; records use at most once a minute).

src/lib/server/db/schema.ts matchMessages (line ~284): `authorId: uuid('author_id').references(() => users.id, { onDelete: 'cascade' }),` (drop .notNull(); comment '`null` for messages posted with an API key.'), add `/** The name of the API key that posted it, copied so the label stays when the key is revoked. */ apiKeyName: text('api_key_name'),`. Then `corepack pnpm db:generate --name api_key_messages` (prefix $env:DATABASE_URL='postgres://root:mysecretpassword@localhost:5432/local'; if needed) and `corepack pnpm db:migrate`. Expect drizzle/0004_api_key_messages.sql with ALTER COLUMN "author_id" DROP NOT NULL and ADD COLUMN "api_key_name" text, plus meta/0004_snapshot.json and the _journal.json entry.

src/lib/server/services/chat.ts: ChatMessage gets `/** The user who wrote it; `null` when an API key did. */ author: { username: string; displayName: string; avatarUrl: string | null } | null;` and `/** The name of the API key that wrote it. */ apiKey: string | null;`. listMessages: `.leftJoin(users, eq(matchMessages.authorId, users.id))` and select `apiKey: matchMessages.apiKeyName` (Drizzle returns `author: null` when the joined columns are all null). postMessage(tournament, matchId, author: { userId: string; organizer: boolean } | { apiKeyName: string }, body): keep the match lookup; for `'apiKeyName' in author` skip the player check and insert `{ matchId, authorId: null, apiKeyName: author.apiKeyName, asOrganizer: true, body }`, message = { ..., author: null, apiKey: author.apiKeyName }; user path unchanged plus `apiKey: null`. Both publish { type: 'chat', matchId, message }. Update the doc comment: API keys write as organizers, labelled with the key's name.

src/lib/components/MatchChat.svelte line 23: `{message.author?.displayName ?? message.apiKey}`; after the organizer badge add `{#if message.apiKey}{m.chat_api_key()}{/if}`. src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/[id]/+page.svelte line 130: `

{match.decidedBy === 'api_key' ? m.room_by_api_key() : match.decidedBy ? m.room_by_organizer() : m.room_by_players()}

`. messages/en.json: append `"chat_api_key": "API key"` and `"room_by_api_key": "This result was set through the API."`.

New src/lib/server/auth/apiKey.ts: imports `error, type RequestEvent` from '@sveltejs/kit', verifyApiKey from '#lib/server/services/apiKeys.ts', getTournamentById from '#lib/server/services/tournaments.ts'. `/** The organization a REST API request acts for, and the key's name for what it writes. */ export type ApiKeyAccess = NonNullable<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof verifyApiKey>>>;`. `/** Guards the REST API: requires `Authorization: Bearer <key>` with a valid key of any organization. */ export async function requireApiKey(event: Pick<RequestEvent, 'request'>)` -> match `/^Bearer (\S+)$/i` on the header, else error(401, 'Send an API key in the Authorization header: Bearer tm_….'); key = await verifyApiKey(token) ?? error(401, 'The API key is invalid or has been revoked.'). `/** A tournament of the key's organization. Other organizations' tournaments are not found either. */ export async function requireApiTournament(key: ApiKeyAccess, tournamentId: string)` -> getTournamentById; if (!t || t.orgId !== key.orgId) error(404, 'Tournament not found.'); return t.

New src/lib/server/auth/apiKey.db.spec.ts (db project; pattern organizations.db.spec.ts with resetDatabase/createUser/createOrganization/createApiKey/revokeApiKey/listApiKeys, `isHttpError(e, 401)`): valid `Bearer <key>` returns { orgId, name: 'Bot' }; missing header, 'Basic abc', 'Bearer nope', a tampered key and a revoked key all reject with 401; requireApiTournament returns the own-org tournament and rejects with 404 for another org's tournament and for crypto.randomUUID(); throttle: verifyApiKey(key, t0) sets lastUsedAt t0, verifyApiKey(key, t0+30_000) keeps t0, verifyApiKey(key, t0+60_000) sets t0+60_000 (read via listApiKeys).

src/lib/server/services/matches.db.spec.ts: hoist `org` to a `let` in beforeEach; fix the chat test map to `m.author?.username`. Add tests: (a) reportForParticipant for both entrants with the same scores -> 'saved' then 'agreed', match completed, decidedBy null, stored row source 'participant' with apiKeyId = key id and userId null; (b) a player reportResult then a different reportForParticipant for the opponent -> 'disputed'; (c) reportForParticipant with a participant not in the match rejects with a ServiceError of kind 'invalid' (assert `{ kind: 'invalid' }` via rejects.toMatchObject); (d) setMatchResult(..., { apiKeyId }) -> decidedBy 'api_key' and one stored row source 'api_key'; (e) postMessage(tournament, semi.id, { apiKeyName: 'Bot' }, 'Final is up') returns { asOrganizer: true, author: null, apiKey: 'Bot' }, appears in listMessages, is published as a chat event, and keeps apiKey 'Bot' after revokeApiKey. Get the key id with `(await verifyApiKey((await createApiKey(org.id, 'Bot', owner.id)).key))!.id`.

src/lib/server/services/tournaments.db.spec.ts: deleteDraftTournament deletes a draft (getTournamentById -> undefined) and rejects a published one with kind 'conflict'; setSeeds reorders (listParticipants seeds follow the order), rejects a missing or duplicated id with kind 'invalid', rejects after start with 'already started'; removeParticipant/setCheckedIn with crypto.randomUUID() reject with kind 'not_found'; addParticipant('nobody') rejects with kind 'invalid'; setStructure after start rejects with kind 'conflict'.

src/lib/server/services/requirements.spec.ts: parseModuleConfig(tetrio, { minRank: 'x', maxRank: 'a' }) -> { ok: false, error: 'TETR.IO: Minimum rank must not be above maximum rank.' } and a valid config -> ok; parseRequirements with [tetrio]: unknown module 'steam' -> 'There is no auth module called "steam".', duplicate tetrio -> 'TETR.IO is required twice.', invalid config -> the module error, valid -> ok with the parsed config.

findings: Done as specified. Migration generated by drizzle-kit (no DATABASE_URL prefix needed): drizzle/0004_api_key_messages.sql (ALTER COLUMN author_id DROP NOT NULL; ADD COLUMN api_key_name text) + drizzle/meta/0004_snapshot.json + _journal.json entry; db:migrate applied to the dev db. Verification: db:migrate OK; check 0 errors/0 warnings; test:unit --run 25 files / 303 tests pass (baseline 289 + 14 new: apiKey.db.spec.ts 4, matches.db.spec.ts 5, tournaments.db.spec.ts 3, requirements.spec.ts 2); format + lint clean. Notes for FEAT-002: reportResult/reportForParticipant share a private `report()`; reportResult's return type is now inferred (still 'saved'|'agreed'|'disputed'). addParticipant returns the new participant id. postMessage for keys skips the player check and stores authorId null, apiKeyName, asOrganizer true. requireApiTournament calls getTournamentById directly, so the route params must be validated as uuids first (tournamentParams) or Postgres will throw on a non-uuid id. Room page shows m.room_by_api_key() when decidedBy is 'api_key'; MatchChat shows the key name plus an 'API key' badge next to the Organizer badge.
